description: Reschedule an appointment. Moves a pending or confirmed appointment to a new date and time after checking the slot is free (its own current slot does not count as taken), updates the connected calendars, and fires appointment.rescheduled. The customer is not messaged. A booking with no conversation must also fall inside business hours. 400 invalid_param for a time in the past, 404 not_found for an unknown id, 409 slot_unavailable when the slot is taken or outside business hours, 409 not_active when the appointment is not pending or confirmed.
name: reschedule_appointment
